schema.sharedShape: Mỗi khoá bên dưới đều có cùng một hình dạng:

glossary.$comment: The chosen Vietnamese equivalent of every recurring term on the site and in the specification. Product and command names stay English by policy: Leji, LejiAI, Contexing, and every CLI name, flag, path and JSON key.
glossary.mechanical: nằm trong cơ chế vận hành, không dựa vào thiện chí
glossary.mechanical forcing function: biện pháp cưỡng chế nằm trong cơ chế vận hành
glossary.cumulative: mức sau bao hàm mức trước
glossary.$comment-availability: Kept against the Kubernetes vi rendering tính sẵn sàng, which is the uptime sense; Leji's availability is that the pinned content is present.
glossary.$comment-docs: Rendered tài liệu wherever it abbreviates documentation; the directory named docs/ is a path and stays English.
glossary.$comment-ai-agent: The compound keeps the English word order as a fixed term and is never reversed in Vietnamese.
glossary.$comment-guardrails: Introduced in full as các quy tắc giới hạn hoạt động của agent where the term is first explained, then shortened to ràng buộc bảo vệ; lan can bảo vệ was dropped because it reads as a physical railing.
glossary.$comment-onboarding: The loanword is kept because nhập môn names an introductory course, not the act of bringing someone into a project.
glossary.$comment-validate: Kept against the Kubernetes vi rendering xác thực, which is Vietnamese for authentication; kiểm tra is what git's own Vietnamese uses.
glossary.$comment-mount: Kept English because Leji uses it as a countable noun, though git, GTK and Kubernetes vi all render the verb as gắn.
glossary.$comment-pin: The noun stays English because it names the manifest field pin that the prose points at; the verb and the adjective are ghim, as in phiên bản đã ghim and mount có ghim.
glossary.$comment-witness: Rendered by what the reference does: chứng nhân denotes a witness, while chứng kiến is a verb meaning to witness an event.
glossary.$comment-resolver: Kept English because the specification and the guide name the component that way throughout, the way mount and manifest are kept.
glossary.$comment-stale: Kept against the git vi rendering đã cũ, which only says old; lỗi thời is the idiomatic word for out-of-date documentation.
glossary.$comment-intent: Kept against the semver vi rendering ý định, a private plan; chủ ý carries the deliberate, recorded purpose this principle needs.
glossary.$comment-commercial-gate: Rendered as a barrier to entry, because cổng thương mại reads as a commercial portal rather than a prerequisite.
glossary.Intent over instructions: Chủ ý thay vì chỉ dẫn
glossary.A circle, not a tier: Một vòng tròn, không phải một tầng
glossary.Mechanism over goodwill: Cơ chế thay vì thiện chí
